title: Audit shard orphaning post KMS epoch merge - reconciliation & backfill plan
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: During the automated KMS epoch rewrap deployed 2026-03-04T22:40Z we observed a 2hr window where a subset of audit log shards in us-west-2 were marked as STALE and then orphaned after cross-region replication laged. Upstream producers continued writing; downstream consumers reading the canonical shard index skipped the orphaned shards, causing an observable gap in audit events for ~2,300 requests. Root cause hypothesis: race between shard rekeying (epoch bump) and the replication coordinator's shard-owner transition logic, combined with a consumer offset handling bug that treats a missing index entry as terminal. Detection: alerted via missing-sequence alerts in the audit-integrity dashboard. Impact: limited to internal audit visibility (no customer-visible data loss), but regulatory/compliance exposure until reconciliation is completed.
comments: 2026-03-05 - Aisha Kumar: Initial triage. Alerts flagged missing event sequences for audit shards id range 8a-9f in us-west-2. Investigated correlation with KMS epoch rewrap that finished at 22:37Z. Notified SRE and Security. Creating follow-up ticket to track remediation and guardrails.

2026-03-06 - Diego Morales: Confirmed orphaned shard list and started a dry-run reconciliation script against cold storage. Dry-run shows 97% match; ~2.7% of events require ordering fix due to sequence gaps. Deciding between immediate backfill vs staged stream replay to avoid overload on ingestion cluster.

2026-03-08 - Priya Singh (SRE): Load test of backfill shows potential to spike CPU on ingestion nodes by ~40% for 90m. Recommend staged replay with rate limiting and write-throttling to preserve SLOs.
2026-03-10 - Security review (Jared Lin): Compliance accepts staged replay as long as we produce an auditable reconciliation report, sign-off required post-merge.

2026-03-12 - Diego Morales: Implemented reconciliation coordinator skeleton in PR and ran canary on non-prod. Canary validated idempotent replays; PR link below. Next: schedule production window and finalize runbook steps for post-replay verification.
